candidates.context: • New therapeutic indications, • Changes in posology, • Reformulation or other major changes. NAFDAC REGULATORY DIRECTIVE DOCUMENT TITLE: REGULATORY DIRECTIVE ON RISK MANAGEMENT PLAN (RMP) SUBMISSION TO THE PHARMACOVIGILANCE DIRECTORATE DOC. REF. NO.:

candidates.statement: NAFDAC-RDRM-035-00 EFFECTIVE DATE: 09-10-2025 REVIEW DUE DATE: 08-10-2030 Be prepared in accordance with NAFDAC’s GVP Guidelines, and where applicable, align with the most recent EMA RMP format, • Reflect current knowledge and incorporate the most up-to-date safety data, • Include identified risks, potential risks, and missing information, • Describe pharmacovigilance activities (e.g., post-authorization safety studies, patient registries), • Detail risk minimization measures, including targeted communication and educational interventions, • All additional risk minimization measures included in an approved RMP must be accompanied by an effectiveness verification strategy. MAHs shall define clear outcome metrics, timeframes, and methods to assess the effectiveness of each measure.

candidates.statement: 3.3 Update Obligations MAHs are required to update the RMP as new information becomes available and submit revised versions upon NAFDAC’s request, particularly:
